sous_titre: Taux Selic en % par an, de juin 2025 à septembre 2026

juin 2025.texte: From June 2025 to March this year, the Selic rate stood at 15 percent per year, its highest level in nearly 20 years.

juin 2026.texte: cut the Selic rate by 0.25 percentage points on Wednesday (Jun. 17), lowering it from 14.50 percent to 14.25 percent per year

août 2026.texte: cut the benchmark Selic rate by 0.25 percentage point to 14.00% a year on the evening of Wednesday, 5 August 2026

sept. 2026.texte: lower the benchmark Selic rate to 13.75%
